c204_preselected.metric_primary: RQA ratio RTE/LAM on delay-embedded log-volume returns. RTE=Shannon entropy (nats) of white vertical line length (recurrence-time gap) distribution over qualifying gaps w>=w_min excluding trivial self; LAM=RQA laminarism = (sum of vertical line lengths v>=v_min)/(sum of all recurrent points off main diagonal); RATIO_RTE_LAM=RTE/LAM. Params m=2,tau=1,eps=0.5*std(r_window),W_RR=168. Fail-closed NaN/no-signal if RTE undefined/non-finite/degenerate, LAM undefined/non-finite/degenerate (denominator<=0), ratio non-finite, or insufficient qualifying lines/gaps. Trailing/causal only.
